items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And, of course, 'Darling Nellie Gray' was more in keeping with the traditional style that he had established by doing the early 'Loch Lomond' and 'Annie Laurie' thing.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

And, of course, I always liked "The Folks Who Live On The Hill." And, of course, "Darling Nellie Gray" was more in keeping with the traditional style that he had established by doing the early "Loch Lomond" and "Annie Laurie" thing.
And these were all, of course, Claude Thornhill's selections, because he was my mentor.
